name: 10044 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10044 (New York) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10044 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10044 (New York) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
